content.doc_md:
TheALLoperator is used to compare a value 
to every value returned by a subquery.

TheALLoperator evaluates to TRUE ifevery valuein the subquery result-set meet the condition.

TheALLoperator is typically used withWHEREandHAVINGstatements.

Below is a selection from the"Products"table in the Northwind sample database:

And a selection from the"OrderDetails"table:

The following SQL returns the ProductName if ALL the records in the "OrderDetails" table has Quantity equal to 10. This will of course return FALSE 
because the Quantity column has many different values (not only the value of 10):

### Code Snippets

```
SELECT
column_name(s)
FROM
table_name
WHERE
column_name operator
ALL (
subquery
);

---

SELECT ProductName
FROM Products
WHERE ProductID = ALL (
SELECT ProductID
FROM OrderDetails
WHERE Quantity = 10
);
```
